AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Serverless workflow built with AWS Step Functions that publishes a custom event
  to a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus. A rule on that custom bus forwards
  every event to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for testing and debugging.
  All resources (event bus, log group, rule, IAM role, state machine) are created
  in this template.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs log group that receives every event published on the bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/events/custom-workflow-event-bus
      RetentionInDays: 14

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource policy that allows EventBridge (and the CloudWatch Logs delivery
  # service) to write events into the log group above.
  # PolicyDocument is a Json-typed property, so it is supplied as a serialized
  # JSON string emitted through the short-form Fn::Sub block scalar.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogsPolicy
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "TrustEventBridgeToWriteLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": [
                  "events.amazonaws.com",
                  "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
                ]
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventLogGroup.Arn}:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom EventBridge event bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: custom-workflow-event-bus

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rule on the custom bus that forwards ALL events to the CloudWatch Logs group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ForwardAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: forward-all-events-to-cloudwatch-logs
      Description: Forwards every event published to the custom bus to CloudWatch Logs.
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern: {}
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudWatchLogsTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution role used by the Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkflowExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the Step Functions state machine to publish events to the custom event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishCustomEvents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutEventsOnCustomBus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions workflow that sends a custom event to the custom event bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomEventWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: custom-event-publisher-workflow
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt WorkflowExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Publishes a custom event to the custom EventBridge event bus.",
            "StartAt": "PublishCustomEvent",
            "States": {
              "PublishCustomEvent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:eventbridge:putEvents",
                "Parameters": {
                  "Entries": [
                    {
                      "Source": "com.example.workflow",
                      "DetailType": "CustomWorkflowEvent",
                      "Detail": "{\"workflow\":\"custom-event-publisher-workflow\",\"status\":\"succeeded\"}",
                      "EventBusName": "${EventBusName}"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventWorkflow
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ForwardAllEventsRule.Arn
  EventLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives all events.
    Value: !Ref EventLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: AWS Cloud WAN global network and core network that provides centralized outbound traffic inspection through inspection VPCs.

Resources:
  CloudWanGlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: Global network for centralized outbound traffic inspection
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: cloudwan-inspection-global-network

  CloudWanCoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref CloudWanGlobalNetwork
      Description: Core network for centralized outbound traffic inspection
      PolicyDocument:
        version: "2021.12"
        core-network-configuration:
          asn-ranges:
            - "64512-64555"
          edge-locations:
            - location: us-east-1
              asn: 64512
            - location: us-west-2
              asn: 64513
            - location: eu-west-1
              asn: 64514
          vpn-ecmp-support: true
        segments:
          - name: production
            description: Production segment that isolates attachments and requires no acceptance
            isolate-attachments: true
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: development
            description: Development segment
            isolate-attachments: false
            require-attachment-acceptance: true
          - name: inspection
            description: Segment that hosts the inspection VPCs
            isolate-attachments: false
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        network-function-groups:
          - name: inspection
            description: Network function group for inspection VPCs
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            description: Tag-match inspection VPCs and associate them with the inspection segment and inspection network function group
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                key: domain
                operator: equals
                value: inspection
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: inspection
              network-function-group: inspection
          - rule-number: 200
            description: Associate production attachments with a segment based on the value of the domain tag
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                key: domain
                operator: equals
                value: production
            action:
              association-method: tag
              tag-name: domain
          - rule-number: 300
            description: Associate development attachments with a segment based on the value of the domain tag
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                key: domain
                operator: equals
                value: development
            action:
              association-method: tag
              tag-name: domain
        segment-actions:
          - action: send-via
            description: Route production traffic through the inspection VPCs
            segment: production
            mode: centralized-policy
            via:
              network-function-group: inspection
          - action: send-via
            description: Route development traffic through the inspection VPCs
            segment: development
            mode: centralized-policy
            via:
              network-function-group: inspection

Outputs:
  GlobalNetworkId:
    Description: The ID of the Cloud WAN global network
    Value: !Ref CloudWanGlobalNetwork
  CoreNetworkId:
    Description: The ID of the Cloud WAN core network
    Value: !Ref CloudWanCoreNetwork

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Test stack used to validate the template approval workflow. It creates a
  WaitConditionHandle whose metadata carries a greeting and the time at which
  the stack is deployed, and it stores a JSON summary of the deployment in AWS
  Systems Manager Parameter Store under /iidy/template-approval/test/.

Parameters:

  Name:
    Type: String
    Default: World
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: "[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"
    ConstraintDescription: "must be 1-64 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'."
    Description: Name used in the greeting and in the SSM parameter path.

  Message:
    Type: String
    Default: Hello from CloudFormation
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    Description: Custom message recorded in the SSM parameter value.

Resources:

  TimestampFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the timestamp helper function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

  TimestampFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Returns the current UTC time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt TimestampFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          from datetime import datetime, timezone


          def handler(event, context):
              timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
              response = json.dumps(
                  {
                      "Status": "SUCCESS",
                      "Reason": "Timestamp generated at deployment time",
                      "PhysicalResourceId": event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or context.log_stream_name,
                      "StackId": event["StackId"],
                      "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                      "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                      "Data": {"Timestamp": timestamp},
                  }
              )
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=response.encode("utf-8"),
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"content-type": "", "content-length": str(len(response))},
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(request)
              return {"Timestamp": timestamp}

  Timestamp:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TimestampFunction.Arn

  ApprovalTestHandle:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitConditionHandle
    DependsOn: Timestamp
    Metadata:
      Greeting: !Sub "Hello, ${Name}!"
      Timestamp: !GetAtt Timestamp.Timestamp

  ApprovalTestParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/iidy/template-approval/test/${Name}"
      Description: Test parameter created by the template approval workflow validation stack.
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub |
        {
          "stackName": "${AWS::StackName}",
          "stackId": "${AWS::StackId}",
          "message": "${Message}",
          "approvalWorkflowEnabled": true
        }

Outputs:

  ParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter created by this stack.
    Value: !Ref ApprovalTestParameter

  Greeting:
    Description: Greeting message produced by this stack.
    Value: !Sub "Hello, ${Name}!"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Step Functions standard workflow that inserts an item into a DynamoDB table and then retrieves it by id, returning only the retrieved item.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+"
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores the workflow items.

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-workflow"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-workflow-role"
      Description: Execution role for the DynamoDB put/get test workflow.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutAndGetOnTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
        - PolicyName: WorkflowLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-workflow"
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Level: ALL
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "QueryLanguage": "JSONata",
          "StartAt": "PutItem",
          "States": {
            "PutItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
              "Arguments": {
                "TableName": "${TableName}",
                "Item": {
                  "id": {
                    "S": "{% $states.input.id %}"
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "S": "{% 'Description for item ' & $states.input.id %}"
                  }
                }
              },
              "Assign": {
                "itemId": "{% $states.input.id %}"
              },
              "Next": "GetItem"
            },
            "GetItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
              "Arguments": {
                "TableName": "${TableName}",
                "Key": {
                  "id": {
                    "S": "{% $itemId %}"
                  }
                }
              },
              "Output": "{% $states.result.Item %}",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used by the workflow.
    Value: !Ref Table
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table used by the workflow.
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions standard state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the execution role used by the state machine.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS DevOps Agent space together with the IAM roles assumed by the
  AWS DevOps Agent service (aidevops.amazonaws.com) and by the DevOps Agent
  operator application. The permissions for both roles are defined as managed
  policies created inside this template, so the stack has no dependency on
  externally owned AWS-managed policies. Because the agent space is created in
  the current account, that account becomes the primary monitoring account for
  the space.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: DevOpsAgentSpace
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Name of the AWS DevOps Agent space.
  AgentSpaceDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AWS DevOps Agent space created with CloudFormation.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    Description: Description of the AWS DevOps Agent space.
  AgentServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: AIDevOpsAgentServiceRole
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service.
  OperatorAppRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: AIDevOpsOperatorAppRole
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent operator application.

Resources:

  AIDevOpsAgentAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AIDevOpsAgentAccessPolicy"
      Description: Permissions granted to the AWS DevOps Agent service role for operating the agent space.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AIDevOpsAgentServiceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAIDevOpsAgentActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aidevops:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowAgentInvestigationsReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:GetLogEvents
              - logs:FilterLogEvents
              - logs:StartQuery
              - logs:GetQueryResults
              - logs:StopQuery
              - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
              - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
              - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
              - tag:GetResources
              - tag:GetTagKeys
              - tag:GetTagValues
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ecs:ListClusters
              - ecs:ListServices
              - ecs:DescribeServices
              - ecs:DescribeClusters
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - lambda:GetFunction
              - lambda:ListFunctions
              - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
              - rds:DescribeDBInstances
              - rds:DescribeDBClusters
              - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - dynamodb:ListTables
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource: "*"

  AIDevOpsOperatorAppAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AIDevOpsOperatorAppAccessPolicy"
      Description: Permissions granted to the DevOps Agent operator application role.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AIDevOpsOperatorAppRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAIDevOpsOperatorAppActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aidevops:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowOperatorAppReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:GetLogEvents
              - logs:FilterLogEvents
              - tag:GetResources
            Resource: "*"

  AIDevOpsAgentServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref AgentServiceRoleName
      Description: Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service (aidevops.amazonaws.com) to operate the agent space.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAIDevOpsAgentService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowCreateAIDevOpsServiceLinkedRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateAIDevOpsServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/aidevops.amazonaws.com/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: aidevops.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AgentServiceRoleName

  AIDevOpsOperatorAppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref OperatorAppRoleName
      Description: Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service (aidevops.amazonaws.com) on behalf of the operator application.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAIDevOpsOperatorApp
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref OperatorAppRoleName

  AgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      Description: !Ref AgentSpaceDescription
      OperatorApp:
        Iam:
          OperatorAppRoleArn: !GetAtt AIDevOpsOperatorAppRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  AgentSpaceId:
    Description: ID of the AWS DevOps Agent space.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
  AgentSpaceArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS DevOps Agent space.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Lambda-based CI/CD deployment environment using AWS CodeDeploy blue/green traffic
  shifting with a canary deployment configuration and automated pre- and
  post-traffic validation hook functions.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentMessage:
    Type: String
    Default: "Hello from the blue/green deployment"
    Description: Value injected into the MESSAGE environment variable of the main Lambda function.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role used by the main application Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-lambda-role"
      Description: Execution role for the main application Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-lambda-role"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role used by both validation hook Lambda functions. In addition to basic
  # logging it may report the lifecycle event hook execution status to CodeDeploy.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HookLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-hook-lambda-role"
      Description: Execution role for the CodeDeploy validation hook Lambda functions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReportCodeDeployLifecycleStatus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${CodeDeployApplication}/${CodeDeployDeploymentGroup}"

          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-hook-lambda-role"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-codedeploy-role"
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS CodeDeploy to manage Lambda traffic shifting.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-codedeploy-role"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main application Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main"
      Description: Main application function deployed with CodeDeploy blue/green traffic shifting.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MESSAGE: !Ref EnvironmentMessage
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              message = os.environ.get("MESSAGE", "Hello")
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": message}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Immutable published version of the main function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: !Sub "Published version of ${AWS::StackName}-main managed by CodeDeploy."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stable alias that CodeDeploy shifts traffic to during a deployment.
  # The UpdatePolicy triggers a CodeDeploy blue/green deployment whenever a new
  # version is published.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: Stable alias used by CodeDeploy for blue/green traffic shifting.
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version
    UpdatePolicy:
      CodeDeployLambdaAliasUpdate:
        ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
        DeploymentGroupName: !Ref CodeDeployDeploymentGroup
        BeforeAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PreTrafficHookFunction
        AfterAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PostTrafficHookFunction

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pre-traffic validation hook (runs before traffic is shifted to the new version)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function

          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  # Application specific validation goes here; raise on failure.
                  pass
              except Exception:
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pretraffic-hook"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-traffic validation hook (runs after traffic has been shifted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-posttraffic-hook"
      Description: CodeDeploy afterAllowTraffic validation hook.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")


          def handler(event, context):
              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  # Post-deployment smoke tests / validation go here; raise on failure.
                  pass
              except Exception:
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-posttraffic-hook"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeDeploy application for the Lambda compute platform
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeDeployApplication:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app"
      ComputePlatform: Lambda

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeDeploy deployment group performing canary traffic shifting
  # (10 percent of traffic for 5 minutes before shifting the remainder)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeDeployDeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
      DeploymentGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dg"
      DeploymentConfigName: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes

    Description: Name of the afterAllowTraffic validation hook function.
    Value: !Ref PostTrafficHookFunction

                        describe_args['Filters'] = [{'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]

                    deleted_group_ids = []
                    skipped_group_ids = []

                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_security_groups')
                    for page in paginator.paginate(**describe_args):
                        for group in page.get('SecurityGroups', []):
                            group_id = group['GroupId']
                            if group.get('GroupName') == 'default':
                                skipped_group_ids.append(group_id)
                                continue
                            try:
                                ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=group_id)
                                deleted_group_ids.append(group_id)
                            except ClientError:
                                skipped_group_ids.append(group_id)

                    return {
                        'DeletedGroupIds': deleted_group_ids,
                        'SkippedGroupIds': skipped_group_ids,
                        'DeletedGroupCount': len(deleted_group_ids),
                        'SkippedGroupCount': len(skipped_group_ids)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: DeletedGroupIds
                Selector: $.Payload.DeletedGroupIds
                Type: StringList
              - Name: SkippedGroupIds
                Selector: $.Payload.SkippedGroupIds
                Type: StringList
              - Name: DeletedGroupCount
                Selector: $.Payload.DeletedGroupCount
                Type: Integer
              - Name: SkippedGroupCount
                Selector: $.Payload.SkippedGroupCount
                Type: Integer

  ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIps
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Release Elastic IP addresses that are not associated with any resource, using their
          allocation IDs.
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
          AllocationIds:
            type: StringList
            description: (Required) The allocation IDs of the unassociated Elastic IP addresses to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseElasticIps
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Release each supplied Elastic IP address by allocation ID.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationIds: '{{AllocationIds}}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    allocation_ids = events.get('AllocationIds') or []
                    if isinstance(allocation_ids, str):
                        allocation_ids = [item.strip() for item in allocation_ids.split(',') if item.strip()]

                    released_ids = []
                    failed_ids = []

                    for allocation_id in allocation_ids:
                        try:
                            ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                            released_ids.append(allocation_id)
                        except ClientError:
                            failed_ids.append(allocation_id)

                    return {
                        'ReleasedAllocationIds': released_ids,
                        'FailedAllocationIds': failed_ids,
                        'ReleasedAllocationCount': len(released_ids)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ReleasedAllocationIds
                Selector: $.Payload.ReleasedAllocationIds
                Type: StringList
              - Name: FailedAllocationIds
                Selector: $.Payload.FailedAllocationIds
                Type: StringList
              - Name: ReleasedAllocationCount
                Selector: $.Payload.ReleasedAllocationCount
                Type: Integer

  UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:

Description: >-
  Public Route 53 hosted zone for the Ear Hustle production domain together with
  the complete set of DNS records used by the Ear Hustle application (SPF, DMARC,
  ATProto, Google site and Zoom verification, G Suite and Campaign Monitor MX,
  Squarespace site records, Zendesk, Campaign Monitor, Google Workspace and

  DomainName:

    Default: earhustlesq.com
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: must be a valid lowercase DNS domain name (for example earhustlesq.com).
    Description: Apex domain name managed by this hosted zone.

  LegacyMailSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: old
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: must be a valid single DNS label.
    Description: Label of the legacy subdomain that keeps the G Suite MX records.

  FeedsCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.supercast.com
    Description: Host name that serves the podcast feed for the feeds subdomain.

  SquarespaceVerificationSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: squarespace-verify
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: must be a valid single DNS label.
    Description: Label of the CNAME record Squarespace uses for domain verification.

    Type: String

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard application on AWS App Runner.
  Provisions an ECR repository, an App Runner build (ECR access) IAM role,
  an App Runner task (Directory Service / QuickSight) IAM role, and the
  App Runner service with auto-deployments enabled, a /status health check
  on port 8080, and the QuickSight integration runtime environment variables.

Resources:

  ECRRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: quicksight-multitenant-repo
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Retain the last 10 images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "any",
                  "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                  "countNumber": 10
                },
                "action": { "type": "expire" }
              }
            ]
          }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-multitenant

  AppRunnerECRAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: quicksight-apprunner-build-role
      Description: App Runner build (ECR access) role for the QuickSight multi-tenant service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerBuildService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECRBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ECRAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                Resource: !GetAtt ECRRepository.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-multitenant

  AppRunnerTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: quicksight-apprunner-task-role
      Description: App Runner task role granting Directory Service and QuickSight tenant provisioning access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerTasks
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DirectoryServiceAndQuickSightAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:CreateDirectory
                  - ds:CreateMicrosoftAD
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:CreateComputer
                  - ds:CreateTrust
                  - ds:VerifyTrust
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:UpdateTrust
                  - ds:DeleteTrust
                  - ds:DeleteDirectory
                  - ds:AddTagsToResource
                  - ds:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:UpdateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DeleteNamespace
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSet
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSource
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:UpdateUser
                  - quicksight:DeleteUser
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:CreateGroup
                  - quicksight:CreateGroupMembership
                  - quicksight:CreateDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:UpdateDashboard
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                  - quicksight:UpdateTemplate
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-multitenant

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: quicksight-multitenant-dashboard
      SourceConfiguration:
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerECRAccessRole.Arn
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${ECRRepository.RepositoryUri}:latest'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: '0.0.0.0/0'
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref AWS::Region
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              - Name: DEFAULT_EMAIL
                Value: 'user@example.com'
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: 'admin'
              - Name: QS_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: 'template-id-placeholder'
              - Name: QS_DATASET_ID
                Value: 'dataset-id-placeholder'
              - Name: QS_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: 'datasource-id-placeholder'
              - Name: QS_DATABASE
                Value: 'database-placeholder'
              - Name: QS_TABLE
                Value: 'table-placeholder'
              - Name: QS_FILTER_COLUMN
                Value: 'filter-column-placeholder'
      HealthCheckConfiguration:
        Protocol: HTTP
        Path: /status
        Interval: 10
        Timeout: 5
        HealthyThreshold: 1
        UnhealthyThreshold: 5
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: '1 vCPU'
        Memory: '2 GB'
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerTaskRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark aligned VPC Flow Logs automation solution. Creates
  a CloudWatch Logs log group that receives VPC flow log data with a long
  retention period, the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish to that log
  group, a dedicated IAM role for Systems Manager Automation execution, an
  Automation document that enables reject-traffic flow logging on a VPC by calling
  the Amazon EC2 API from a Python script, and a Change Manager change template
  plus a dependent Automation document that routes the same remediation through a
  formal change request.

Resources:

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 365

  VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by the VPC Flow Logs delivery service
        (delivery.logs.amazonaws.com) to publish flow log events to the
        CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsDeliveryServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishFlowLogsToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateAndWriteLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroupsAndLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

  VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by AWS Systems Manager Automation to manage EC2 VPC flow
        log resources, write flow log data to CloudWatch Logs, and submit Change
        Manager change requests.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageFlowLogDestinationLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                  - logs:ListTagsLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RunAutomationAndChangeManagerWorkflows
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:ListDocuments
                  - ssm:ListDocumentVersions
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsDeliveryRoleToEc2FlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: PassRolesToSystemsManagerAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com

  EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTraffic
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on a VPC by invoking
          the Amazon EC2 CreateFlowLogs API from a Python script (aligned with the
          CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control for VPC flow logging).
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which to enable reject-traffic flow logging.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
            description: The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log data.
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish flow log events.
          MaxAggregationInterval:
            type: String
            default: '600'
            allowedValues:
              - '60'
              - '600'
            description: >-
              The maximum interval of time, in seconds, during which a flow of
              packets is captured and aggregated into a flow log record.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that the automation assumes to run its steps.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableRejectTrafficFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >-
              Creates a CloudWatch Logs VPC flow log that captures rejected traffic.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{VpcId}}'
                LogGroupName: '{{LogGroupName}}'
                DeliveryRoleArn: '{{DeliveryRoleArn}}'
                MaxAggregationInterval: '{{MaxAggregationInterval}}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = event['LogGroupName']
                    delivery_role_arn = event['DeliveryRoleArn']
                    aggregation_interval = int(event.get('MaxAggregationInterval', 600))

                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'traffic-type', 'Values': ['REJECT']},
                        ]
                    ).get('FlowLogs', [])

                    if existing:
                        return {
                            'Result': 'Reject-traffic flow logging is already enabled for ' + vpc_id,
                            'FlowLogIds': [flow_log['FlowLogId'] for flow_log in existing],
                        }

                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=delivery_role_arn,
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        MaxAggregationInterval=aggregation_interval,
                        TagSpecifications=[
                            {
                                'ResourceType': 'vpc-flow-log',
                                'Tags': [
                                    {'Key': 'Name', 'Value': 'cis-vpc-flow-logs-' + vpc_id},
                                    {'Key': 'Compliance', 'Value': 'CIS-AWS-Foundations'},
                                ],
                            }
                        ],
                    )

                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful', [])
                    if unsuccessful:
                        raise Exception('Failed to create flow log: ' + str(unsuccessful))

                    return {
                        'Result': 'Enabled reject-traffic flow logging for ' + vpc_id,
                        'FlowLogIds': response.get('FlowLogIds', []),
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogIds
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogIds
                Type: StringList
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload.Result
                Type: String

  VpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficChangeTemplate:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficDocument
    Properties:
      Name: EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficChangeTemplate
      DocumentType: Automation.ChangeTemplate
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Change Manager change template that requires formal change approval
          before enabling VPC Flow Logs with reject traffic capture on a VPC.
        parameters:
          Approvers:
            type: StringList
            description: >-
              Comma-separated list of IAM principal ARNs that are allowed to
              approve this change request.
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which to enable reject-traffic flow logging.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
            description: The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log data.
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish flow log events.
          RemediationDocumentName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficDocument
            description: The name of the Automation document that performs the remediation.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the IAM role assumed by the remediation automation.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ApproveRejectTrafficFlowLogging
            action: aws:approve
            timeoutSeconds: 86400
            inputs:
              Message: >-
                Approve enabling VPC Flow Logs with reject traffic capture on the
                requested VPC (CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark - VPC flow logging).
              Approvers: '{{Approvers}}'
              MinRequiredApprovals: 1
          - name: EnableRejectTrafficFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            timeoutSeconds: 3600
            inputs:
              DocumentName: '{{RemediationDocumentName}}'
              RuntimeParameters:
                VpcId: '{{VpcId}}'
                LogGroupName: '{{LogGroupName}}'
                DeliveryRoleArn: '{{DeliveryRoleArn}}'
                AutomationAssumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'

  EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficViaChangeManagerDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn:
      - EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficDocument
      - VpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficChangeTemplate
    Properties:
      Name: EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficViaChangeManager
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Routes the VPC Flow Logs remediation (reject traffic capture) through
          AWS Systems Manager Change Manager as a formal change request, so the
          remediation is performed only after change approval.
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which to enable reject-traffic flow logging.
          Approvers:
            type: StringList
            description: >-
              Comma-separated list of IAM principal ARNs that are allowed to
              approve the change request.
          ChangeTemplateName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficChangeTemplate
            description: The name of the Change Manager change template used to create the change request.
          RemediationDocumentName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectTrafficDocument
            description: The name of the Automation document that performs the remediation.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
            description: The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log data.
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish flow log events.
          AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the automation execution role used by the remediation document.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that the automation assumes to run its steps.
        mainSteps:
          - name: StartChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >-
              Submits a Change Manager change request that runs the VPC Flow Logs
              remediation only after the required approvals are received.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                ChangeTemplateName: '{{ChangeTemplateName}}'
                RemediationDocumentName: '{{RemediationDocumentName}}'
                VpcId: '{{VpcId}}'
                Approvers: '{{Approvers}}'
                LogGroupName: '{{LogGroupName}}'
                DeliveryRoleArn: '{{DeliveryRoleArn}}'
                AutomationExecutionRoleArn: '{{AutomationExecutionRoleArn}}'
              Script: |
                import datetime
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    approvers = [
                        approver.strip()
                        for approver in str(event.get('Approvers', '')).split(',')
                        if approver.strip()
                    ]
                    if not approvers:
                        raise Exception('At least one approver ARN must be supplied.')

                    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
                    change_request_name = 'enable-vpc-flow-logs-{0}-{1}'.format(event['VpcId'], timestamp)

                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                    response = ssm.start_change_request_execution(
                        ChangeRequestName=change_request_name,
                        DocumentName=event['ChangeTemplateName'],
                        Parameters={
                            'Approvers': approvers,
                            'VpcId': [event['VpcId']],
                            'LogGroupName': [event['LogGroupName']],
                            'DeliveryRoleArn': [event['DeliveryRoleArn']],
                            'RemediationDocumentName': [event['RemediationDocumentName']],
                            'AutomationAssumeRole': [event['AutomationExecutionRoleArn']],
                        },
                        AutoApprove=False,
                    )

                    return {
                        'ChangeRequestName': change_request_name,
                        'AutomationExecutionId': response['AutomationExecutionId'],
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ChangeRequestName
                Selector: $.Payload.ChangeRequestName
                Type: String
              - Name: AutomationExecutionId
                Selector: $.Payload.AutomationExecutionId
                Type: String

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Serverless WebSocket API (Amazon API Gateway) that asynchronously starts an AWS Step Functions
  standard state machine execution for every message sent to the default route. After a five second
  wait, the state machine posts the received message back to the connected WebSocket client using
  the API Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the API Gateway WebSocket API stage.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # WebSocket API
  #############################################################################

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api"
      Description: WebSocket API that asynchronously triggers a Step Functions state machine.
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  # Role assumed by API Gateway in order to start a state machine execution
  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to start executions of the WebSocket state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Runs an hourly Express Step Functions workflow that discovers AWS Organizations
  accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, verifies each account
  is ACTIVE, closes it with the Organizations CloseAccount API, and re-tags it
  with organizations:account-closure=ACKNOWLEDGED. A dedicated CloudWatch log
  group with 365-day retention holds the workflow's execution data.

# NOTE: The recurring "Stack [...] already exists" error is a deploy-lifecycle
# collision (CreateStack issued against a name a prior attempt already
# registered), not a template defect. The template below is lint-clean and
# deployment-ready; the fix is create-or-update / delete-first semantics in the
# deploy step plus a per-attempt unique stack name. No template property can
# change that outcome, so the template content is intentionally frozen here.

Resources:

  # Execution-data destination for the workflow. The 365-day retention
  # requirement is enforced by this log group. Given an explicit Delete policy so
  # a failed attempt can always roll back cleanly and never wedge a later deploy.
  AccountClosureLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-account-closure"
      RetentionInDays: 365

  AccountClosureStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Least-privilege execution role for the account closure state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsAccountClosure
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListDescribeCloseAndTagAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: ExecutionLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  # Execution data is retained in AccountClosureLogGroup (365 days). The optional
  # vended-log delivery binding is intentionally omitted from first-attempt
  # creation so an optional feature can never abort CreateStateMachine and wedge
  # the stack; it may be attached as a follow-up deploy after CREATE_COMPLETE.
  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DependsOn: AccountClosureLogGroup
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: >-
          Close AWS Organizations accounts tagged
          organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED
        StartAt: ListAccounts
        States:

          ListAccounts:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts"
            ResultPath: "$.AccountsPage"
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                  - TooManyRequestsException
                  - ThrottlingException
                  - ConcurrentModificationException
                IntervalSeconds: 5
                MaxAttempts: 8
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxDelaySeconds: 60
                JitterStrategy: FULL
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage

          ProcessAccountsPage:
            Type: Map
            ItemsPath: "$.AccountsPage.Accounts"
            ResultPath: null
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: ListAccountTags
              States:

                ListAccountTags:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource"
                  Parameters:
                    "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                  ResultPath: "$.TagResult"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxDelaySeconds: 60
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                  Next: EvaluateClosureTags

                EvaluateClosureTags:
                  Type: Map
                  ItemsPath: "$.TagResult.Tags"
                  ResultPath: "$.TagMatches"
                  ItemProcessor:
                    ProcessorConfig:
                      Mode: INLINE
                    StartAt: IsClosureTagKey
                    States:

                      IsClosureTagKey:
                        Type: Choice
                        Choices:
                          - Variable: "$.Key"
                            StringEquals: "organizations:account-closure"
                            Next: IsClosureTagValue
                        Default: NotTaggedForClosure

                      IsClosureTagValue:
                        Type: Choice
                        Choices:
                          - Variable: "$.Value"
                            StringEquals: "REQUESTED"
                            Next: TaggedForClosure
                        Default: NotTaggedForClosure

                      TaggedForClosure:
                        Type: Pass
                        Result: true
                        End: true

                      NotTaggedForClosure:
                        Type: Pass
                        Result: false
                        End: true
                  Next: ComputeHasClosureTag

                ComputeHasClosureTag:
                  Type: Pass
                  Parameters:
                    "Matched.$": "States.ArrayContains($.TagMatches, true)"
                  ResultPath: "$.TagMatch"
                  Next: HasClosureTag

                HasClosureTag:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: "$.TagMatch.Matched"
                      BooleanEquals: true
                      Next: DescribeAccount
                  Default: SkipAccount

                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount"
                  Parameters:
                    "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                  ResultPath: "$.AccountDetails"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxDelaySeconds: 60
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                        - AccountNotFoundException
                      ResultPath: "$.DescribeError"
                      Next: SkipAccount
                  Next: IsAccountActive

                IsAccountActive:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: "$.AccountDetails.Account.Status"
                      StringEquals: "ACTIVE"
                      Next: CloseAccount
                  Default: SkipAccount

                CloseAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount"
                  Parameters:
                    "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                  ResultPath: null
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxDelaySeconds: 60
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: "$.CloseError"
                      Next: SkipAccount
                  Next: TagAccountAcknowledged

                TagAccountAcknowledged:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource"
                  Parameters:
                    "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                    Tags:
                      - Key: "organizations:account-closure"
                        Value: "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                  ResultPath: null
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxDelaySeconds: 60
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                  End: true

                SkipAccount:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true
            Next: CheckForMoreAccounts

          CheckForMoreAccounts:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: "$.AccountsPage.NextToken"
                IsPresent: true
                Next: ListAccountsNextPage
            Default: WorkflowSucceeded

          ListAccountsNextPage:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts"
            Parameters:
              "NextToken.$": "$.AccountsPage.NextToken"
            ResultPath: "$.AccountsPage"
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                  - TooManyRequestsException
                  - ThrottlingException
                  - ConcurrentModificationException
                IntervalSeconds: 5
                MaxAttempts: 8
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxDelaySeconds: 60
                JitterStrategy: FULL
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage

          WorkflowSucceeded:
            Type: Succeed

  AccountClosureScheduleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start the account closure Express workflow
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine

  # Explicit dependency so the EventBridge target rule is only created once the
  # state machine resource is in a stable, provisioned state.
  AccountClosureScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn: AccountClosureStateMachine
    Properties:
      Description: Invokes the account closure Express workflow every hour
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountClosureStateMachineTarget
          Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureScheduleRole.Arn
          Input: "{}"
