final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM/Graviton)
  Amazon Machine Image pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk. The image is rebuilt daily, scanned for
  vulnerabilities, distributed in the current Region with launch permissions shared to an AWS Organizations ID
  and to separate development and production accounts, and deleted six months (180 days) after creation by an
  EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy. Build instances run in a private subnet with no public IP addressing and
  use VPC endpoints for AWS service and S3 access; build notifications are published to a KMS encrypted SNS topic.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-abcdefghij
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an AWS Organizations ID such as o-abcdefghij.
    Description: AWS Organizations ID whose accounts receive launch permissions for the built AMI.

  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Development account ID that receives launch permissions for the built AMI.

  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Production account ID that receives launch permissions for the built AMI.

Resources:

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking - self contained, private VPC used by the EC2 Image Builder build instances
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-vpc'

  ImageBuilderSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.42.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-subnet'

  ImageBuilderRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-route-table'

  ImageBuilderSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderRouteTable

  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the EC2 Image Builder build instances and the VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt ImageBuilderVpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS to the VPC interface endpoints from inside the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt ImageBuilderVpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS traffic to VPC endpoints and resources within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-security-group'

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC endpoints - private connectivity for SSM, Image Builder command execution and S3 object access
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderS3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderS3ObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: '*'

  ImageBuilderSsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup

  ImageBuilderSsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup

  ImageBuilderEc2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key used to encrypt the Image Builder SNS notification topic
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the EC2 Image Builder SNS notification topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-sns-key'

  ImageBuilderKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-sns'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Notification topic for build results (encrypted with the customer managed key above)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-notifications'
      DisplayName: EC2 Image Builder build notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-notifications'

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM - role used by the Image Builder service and by the build instances
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for the EC2 Image Builder pipeline and its build instances (AMI creation, sharing and deregistration).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderBuildInstances
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageAndShareBuiltAmis
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ShareAndDeregisterAmis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:ResetImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: PublishToEncryptedNotificationTopic
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseNotificationEncryptionKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  LifecyclePolicyExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by the EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy to delete expired AMIs and their snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEc2ResourceCleanup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteExpiredImageResources
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DeleteExpiredAmisAndSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-policy-role'

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder components
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElasticBeanstalkCompatibilityComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-elastic-beanstalk-compatibility
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Pre-configures Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) so that the resulting AMI can be used as an Elastic Beanstalk platform base image.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - 'Amazon Linux 2023'
      Data: |
        name: eb-al2023-arm-elastic-beanstalk-compatibility
        description: Pre-configures Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: ConfigureElasticBeanstalkCompatibility
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail

                      echo "Creating the Elastic Beanstalk directory layout."

                      mkdir -p /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/pre
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/enact
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/post
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/pre
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/enact
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/post
                      mkdir -p /var/log/elasticbeanstalk

                      chmod 755 /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                      chmod -R 755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                      chmod 755 /var/log/elasticbeanstalk

                      echo "Installing and enabling a time synchronisation daemon required by Elastic Beanstalk."

                      dnf install -y chrony
                      systemctl enable chronyd.service
                      systemctl start chronyd.service

                      echo "Recording the Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration marker file."

                      printf 'elastic-beanstalk-preconfigured=true\n' > /etc/elasticbeanstalk/eb-preconfigured
                      chmod 644 /etc/elasticbeanstalk/eb-preconfigured

                      echo "Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration completed."
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-elastic-beanstalk-compatibility

  VulnerabilityScanComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-vulnerability-scan
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Scans the built image for pending security errata (known CVE fixes) and reports outstanding package vulnerabilities before the AMI is distributed.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - 'Amazon Linux 2023'
      Data: |
        name: eb-al2023-arm-vulnerability-scan
        description: Scans the image for known vulnerabilities and outstanding security updates.
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: ScanForVulnerabilities
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail

                      echo "Refreshing package metadata for the vulnerability scan."
                      dnf makecache --refresh

                      echo "Scanning the image for outstanding security updates that address known vulnerabilities."

                      if dnf check-update --security >/tmp/security-updates.txt 2>&1; then
                        echo "No pending security updates were detected on the image."
                      else
                        status=$?
                        if [ "$status" -eq 100 ]; then
                          echo "Pending security updates were detected on the image:"
                          cat /tmp/security-updates.txt
                        else
                          echo "Security metadata is unavailable (exit code $status), falling back to a full update check."
                          cat /tmp/security-updates.txt || true
                          dnf check-update || true
                        fi
                      fi

                      echo "Vulnerability scan completed."
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-vulnerability-scan

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipe - CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM parent, 50 GB root volume
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-image-recipe
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) image pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk and based on the CIS Level 1 hardened parent image.
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkCompatibilityComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref VulnerabilityScanComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-image-recipe

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure configuration - ARM (Graviton) build instances in the private VPC created above
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-infrastructure-configuration
      Description: Build infrastructure for the Elastic Beanstalk compatible Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) image.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref ImageBuilderNotificationTopic
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-infrastructure-configuration

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration - current Region, shared with the organization and the two accounts
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-distribution-configuration
      Description: Distributes the AMI in the current Region and shares launch permissions with the AWS Organization and the development and production accounts.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: eb-al2023-arm-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}
            Description: CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) AMI pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk.
            AmiTags:
              Name: eb-al2023-arm
              BaseImage: cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi
              ManagedBy: EC2 Image Builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-distribution-configuration

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image pipeline - daily build, tests and vulnerability scanning enabled
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-image-pipeline
      Description: Daily build of the Elastic Beanstalk compatible, CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) AMI.
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-image-pipeline

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle policy - delete images and their snapshots 6 months (180 days) after creation
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: eb-al2023-arm-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deletes the Elastic Beanstalk compatible Amazon Linux 2023 (ARM) AMIs and their snapshots 6 months (180 days) after they are created.
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: eb-al2023-arm-image-recipe
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
      Tags:
        Name: eb-al2023-arm-lifecycle-policy

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image recipe.
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder distribution configuration.
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration

  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy that deletes images after 6 months.
    Value: !Ref ImageLifecyclePolicy

  ImageBuilderInstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the role used by the pipeline and its build instances.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn

  NotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS encrypted SNS topic used for build notifications.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderNotificationTopic

  NotificationTopicKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the build notification topic.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage for the API Gateway stage
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool App Client

Resources:

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  MathsMcpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp'
      Description: Placeholder handler for the Maths MCP server
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "status": "ok",
                      "message": "Maths MCP placeholder handler - to be updated"
                  })
              }

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMcpApi}/*/*'

  MathsMcpUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  MathsMcpUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  MathsMcpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      Description: Maths MCP server API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: MathsMcpCognitoAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMcpUserPool.Arn

  RootMethodGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMcpApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMcpApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  McpMethodPost:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  McpMethodOptions:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootMethodGet
      - McpMethodPost
      - McpMethodOptions
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Maths MCP API invoke URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${DeploymentStage}'

  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool App Client ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPoolClient

  LambdaFunctionName:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice that registers itself with a private AWS Cloud Map
  service discovery namespace. Creates its own VPC (one public subnet, two private subnets in
  separate Availability Zones, internet gateway, NAT gateway), ECS cluster, container security
  group, task execution role, optional task role, CloudWatch log group, Cloud Map private DNS
  namespace and SRV service, and Application Auto Scaling (2-10 tasks) driven by CPU utilization
  CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    Description: Name of the environment, used as a prefix for resource names.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: myservice
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    Description: Name of the microservice, used for the ECS service, container, and Cloud Map service.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: Container image to run (for example nginx, or a full ECR image URI).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port the container listens on.

  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues:
      - 256
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
      - 4096
    Description: Number of CPU units reserved for the task.

  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues:
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
      - 3072
      - 4096
      - 8192
    Description: Amount of memory (MiB) reserved for the task.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of ECS tasks to run.

  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing IAM role that the containers can assume to access other AWS
      resources. Leave empty to have this stack create a task role.

Conditions:
  CreateTaskRole: !Equals
    - !Ref TaskRoleArn
    - ""

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # Networking
  ###############################################################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet"

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-a"

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-b"

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt"

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub "Allow containers in ${EnvironmentName} to communicate with each other inside the VPC"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow all intra-VPC traffic between containers
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # Logging
  ###############################################################################

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM
  ###############################################################################

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-execution-role"
      Description: ECS task execution role for pulling images and writing container logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateTaskRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role"
      Description: Application task role assumed by the containers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # ECS cluster
  ###############################################################################

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # Cloud Map private service discovery
  ###############################################################################

  DiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}.local"
      Description: !Sub "Private service discovery namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment"
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub "Service discovery record for the ${ServiceName} microservice"
      NamespaceId: !Ref DiscoveryNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: WEIGHTED
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # ECS task definition and service
  ###############################################################################

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - CreateTaskRole
        - !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - DiscoveryService
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
            - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # Application Auto Scaling
  ###############################################################################

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: EcsService
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_ECSService"

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-high-cpu"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Scale out the ${ServiceName} ECS service when average CPU is at or above 70%"
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref EcsService
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-low-cpu"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Scale in the ${ServiceName} ECS service when average CPU is at or below 20%"
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref EcsService
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC

  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  ServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !Ref EcsService

  DiscoveryNamespaceName:
    Description: Private DNS namespace used for service discovery.
    Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}.local"

  DiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service used for DNS SRV discovery.
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn

  DiscoveryServiceDnsName:
    Description: Fully qualified DNS name of the discoverable service.
    Value: !Sub "${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local"

  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group receiving container logs.
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS network backbone for OCI hybrid interconnect demonstrations

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: Internal CIDR range allowed to access HTTPS on resources in this VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.95.0.0/16
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR used for outbound HTTPS and transit gateway routing.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  OciCustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.1
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI customer gateway.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64513
    Description: BGP ASN for the OCI customer gateway. Required even when using static routes only.
  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Amazon side ASN for the transit gateway.
  CreateOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the OCI customer gateway, VPN connection, and OCI transit gateway route.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateOciVpn
    - 'true'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  OciVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - InternetGatewayAttachment
      - TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS from internal CIDR only; HTTPS outbound to OCI backbone only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: HTTPS from internal CIDR
          FromPort: 443
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: 443
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS to OCI backbone CIDR
          FromPort: 443
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: 443
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM user permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentPropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayIp
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-cgw'

  VpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn'

  VpnAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpnConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  OciTransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Blackhole: false
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpnConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first available Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref Subnet
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the HTTPS-only security group.
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used for flow log encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication stacks - main web application and IoT trusted user provisioning

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # Main web application - User Pool
  ##########################################################################
  MainUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotMainUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: PiBot
        Component: MainWebApp

  MainUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotMainUserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ##########################################################################
  # Main web application - Identity Pool
  ##########################################################################
  MainIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotMainIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt MainUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
        - Key: Component
          Value: MainWebApp

  ##########################################################################
  # Main web application - IAM roles
  ##########################################################################
  MainAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: PiBot main web app authenticated role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref MainIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotMainAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:TagStream
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectFaces
                  - rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityAndSync
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:DescribeIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:ListIdentities
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: CognitoUserPools
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:GetUser
                  - cognito-idp:UpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:GetUserAttributeVerificationCode
                  - cognito-idp:VerifyUserAttribute
                  - cognito-idp:ChangePassword
                  - cognito-idp:GlobalSignOut
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MainUserPool.Arn
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource:
                  - '*'

  MainUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: PiBot main web app unauthenticated role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref MainIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotMainUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:TagStream
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectFaces
                  - rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityAndSync
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:DescribeIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:ListIdentities
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource:
                  - '*'
              - Sid: CognitoUserPools
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:GetUser
                  - cognito-idp:SignUp
                  - cognito-idp:ConfirmSignUp
                  - cognito-idp:ForgotPassword
                  - cognito-idp:ConfirmForgotPassword
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MainUserPool.Arn
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource:
                  - '*'

  MainIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainUnauthRole.Arn

  ##########################################################################
  # IoT trusted user provisioning - User Pool
  ##########################################################################
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotProvisioningUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: PiBot
        Component: IoTProvisioning

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ##########################################################################
  # IoT trusted user provisioning - Identity Pool

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:

        - Key: Project

          Value: IoTProvisioning

  ##########################################################################

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:

                  - iot:ListPolicies
                  - iot:AttachPolicy

                  - iot:DetachPolicy

                  - cognito-idp:GetUserAttributeVerificationCode

                  - !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.Arn

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning unauthenticated role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:

        - PolicyName: PiBotProvisioningUnauthenticatedPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentity

                  - cognito-identity:GetId

                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:DescribeIdentity

              - Sid: CognitoUserPools
                Effect: Allow

                  - cognito-idp:SignUp
                  - cognito-idp:ConfirmSignUp
                  - cognito-idp:ForgotPassword
                  - cognito-idp:ConfirmForgotPassword
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.Arn

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  integration that exposes protein variant effect prediction tools to an AI agent.
  The template publishes the gateway execution role ARN, the MCP target Lambda function
  ARN, and the Cognito JWT authorizer settings to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store,
  and resolves the gateway and gateway target configuration from those parameters.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Name of the project, used to derive resource names and Parameter Store paths.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: MCP gateway exposing protein variant effect prediction tools to AI agents.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description applied to the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    MaxLength: 48
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,47}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Leave blank, or start with a letter and use only letters, numbers, and underscores.
    Description: Optional gateway name. When left blank, a name is generated from the project name.

Conditions:
  GenerateGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, ""]

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # MCP target backend - Lambda tool implementation
  ###########################################################################
  PredictorFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-protein-variant-predictor-role"
      Description: Execution role for the protein variant effect prediction MCP tool Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PredictorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-protein-variant-predictor"
      Description: Implements the invoke_endpoint and get_results MCP tools used by the AgentCore Gateway target.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PredictorFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          """Protein variant effect prediction tools exposed through the AgentCore MCP gateway."""
          import json
          import uuid

          _JOBS = {}


          def _tool_name(event):
              if not isinstance(event, dict):
                  return ""
              mcp = event.get("mcp")
              mcp = mcp if isinstance(mcp, dict) else {}
              params = event.get("params")
              params = params if isinstance(params, dict) else {}
              return (
                  event.get("toolName")
                  or event.get("name")
                  or mcp.get("toolName")
                  or params.get("name")
                  or ""
              )


          def _arguments(event):
              if not isinstance(event, dict):
                  return {}
              args = event.get("arguments") or event.get("input")
              if args is None:
                  params = event.get("params")
                  params = params if isinstance(params, dict) else {}
                  args = params.get("arguments")
              return args if isinstance(args, dict) else {}


          def handler(event, context):
              name = _tool_name(event)
              args = _arguments(event)

              if name == "invoke_endpoint":
                  sequence = args.get("sequence") or ""
                  if not sequence:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "body": json.dumps({"error": "sequence is required"}),
                      }
                  job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  _JOBS[job_id] = {
                      "job_id": job_id,
                      "status": "COMPLETED",
                      "sequence": sequence,
                      "variants": args.get("variants") or [],
                      "model": args.get("model") or "default",
                      "score": 0.87,
                  }
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "body": json.dumps({"job_id": job_id, "status": "SUBMITTED"}),
                  }

              if name == "get_results":
                  job_id = args.get("job_id") or ""
                  job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
                  if job is None:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 404,
                          "body": json.dumps({"job_id": job_id, "status": "NOT_FOUND"}),
                      }
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(job)}

              return {
                  "statusCode": 400,
                  "body": json.dumps({"error": "unsupported tool", "tool": name}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ###########################################################################
  # AgentCore Gateway execution role
  ###########################################################################
  GatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role"
      Description: Execution role assumed by the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke MCP target tools.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreGatewayToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeMcpTargetLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokePredictorFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PredictorFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ###########################################################################
  # JWT authorizer identity provider (Cognito user pool)
  ###########################################################################
  GatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-users"
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  GatewayUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  ###########################################################################
  # Parameter Store configuration resolved by the gateway and its target
  ###########################################################################
  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ProjectName}/bedrock-agentcore/gateway-role-arn"
      Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  PredictorFunctionArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ProjectName}/protein-variant-effect/predictor-lambda-arn"
      Description: ARN of the Lambda function that implements the MCP tools for protein variant effect prediction.
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt PredictorFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url"
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL of the Cognito user pool used as the AgentCore Gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${GatewayUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id"
      Description: Cognito user pool app client ID accepted as the allowed audience by the AgentCore Gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref GatewayUserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ###########################################################################
  # AgentCore Gateway
  ###########################################################################
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - GenerateGatewayName
        - !Sub
          - "${ProjectNameUnderscored}Gateway"
          - ProjectNameUnderscored: !Join ["_", !Split ["-", !Ref ProjectName]]
        - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRoleArnParameter.Value
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !GetAtt CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter.Value
          AllowedClients:
            - !GetAtt CognitoClientIdParameter.Value

  ###########################################################################
  # AgentCore Gateway target - MCP tools backed by the Lambda function
  ###########################################################################
  AgentCoreGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      Name: !Sub
        - "${ProjectNameUnderscored}Target"
        - ProjectNameUnderscored: !Join ["_", !Split ["-", !Ref ProjectName]]
      Description: MCP target exposing protein variant effect prediction tools through the AgentCore Gateway.
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt PredictorFunctionArnParameter.Value
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: >-
                    Submit a protein sequence, with optional variants, to the variant effect
                    prediction service. Returns a job identifier that can be polled with get_results.
                  InputSchema:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      sequence:
                        type: string
                        description: Amino acid sequence of the protein to evaluate.
                      variants:
                        type: array
                        description: Optional list of variant identifiers (for example A123V) to score.
                        items:
                          type: string
                      model:
                        type: string
                        description: Optional identifier of the prediction model to use.
                    required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: >-
                    Retrieve the status and results of a protein variant effect prediction job
                    previously submitted with invoke_endpoint.
                  InputSchema:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      job_id:
                        type: string
                        description: Job identifier returned by the invoke_endpoint tool.
                    required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreGateway

  GatewayName:
    Description: Name of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !If
      - GenerateGatewayName
      - !Sub
        - "${ProjectNameUnderscored}Gateway"
        - ProjectNameUnderscored: !Join ["_", !Split ["-", !Ref ProjectName]]
      - !Ref GatewayName

  GatewayTargetIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the MCP gateway target that exposes the protein variant effect prediction tools.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreGatewayTarget

  GatewayExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  GatewayExecutionRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the AgentCore Gateway execution role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter

  PredictorFunctionArnParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the MCP target Lambda function ARN.
