  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the Cognito discovery URL used by the JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter

  CognitoClientIdParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the Cognito client ID used by the JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Ref CognitoClientIdParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Audit events SQS queue with KMS encryption and key rotation, an optional dead letter
  queue for non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for old messages and DLQ activity,
  and SNS notifications for alarm state changes.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: >-
      Deployment environment. Drives message retention, visibility timeout, DLQ
      creation, and alarm thresholds.

  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Number of receives before a message moves to the DLQ (non-dev only).

  AlertEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address that receives alarm notifications.

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmailAddress, '']]

Resources:

  AuditEventsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for audit events SQS/SNS encryption (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AuditEventsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKmsKey

  AuditEventsDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: !If [IsProd, 120, 60]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DeadLetter

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !If
        - IsProd
        - 1209600
        - !If [IsNonDev, 604800, 345600]
      VisibilityTimeout: !If
        - IsProd
        - 120
        - !If [IsNonDev, 60, 30]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AuditEvents

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-alerts-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKmsKey

  AlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOwnerAccountManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sns:*'
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AlertEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmailAddress

  OldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-old-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Alerts when the age of the oldest audit event exceeds the threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !If [IsProd, 3600, 7200]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  DlqMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Alerts when messages are visible in the audit events dead letter queue.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue (non-dev only).
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn

  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS alert topic.
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: MediaPackage live channel with HLS/DASH origin endpoints and optional VOD workflows.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    Description: Logical name prefix for resource naming.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment tag value.
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional. Name for the S3 bucket to store live-to-VOD archives. If provided, origin endpoints use Origination DENY.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional. Name for the S3 bucket containing VOD source content.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Output type for endpoints and VOD packaging.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name for HLS and DASH endpoints.
  SegmentDuration:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: HLS segment duration in seconds. DASH is hardcoded to 2 seconds.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: Startover window in seconds for origin endpoints.
  CustomTag1Key:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag 1 key.
  CustomTag1Value:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag 1 value.
  CustomTag2Key:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag 2 key.
  CustomTag2Value:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag 2 value.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, ""]]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, ""]]
  CreateVodWorkflow: !And
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateVodHlsConfig: !And
    - !Condition CreateVodWorkflow
    - !Condition CreateHlsEndpoint
  CreateVodDashConfig: !And
    - !Condition CreateVodWorkflow
    - !Condition CreateDashEndpoint
  HasCustomTag1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTag1Key, ""]]
  HasCustomTag2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTag2Key, ""]]

Resources:

  MediaPackageKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for MediaPackage ${NamePrefix} S3 buckets"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  MediaPackageKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-mediapackage"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MediaPackageKmsKey

  ArchiveS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  VodSourceS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-channel"
      Description: !Sub "MediaPackage live channel for ${Environment}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-hls"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref SegmentDuration
        AdMarkers: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-dash"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        Profile: NONE
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-pg"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  VodHlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodHlsConfig
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-hls-pc"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref SegmentDuration
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  VodDashPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodDashConfig
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-dash-pc"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

  VodAsset:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Asset
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-asset"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      SourceArn: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
      SourceRoleArn: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If [HasCustomTag1, {Key: !Ref CustomTag1Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag1Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [HasCustomTag2, {Key: !Ref CustomTag2Key, Value: !Ref CustomTag2Value}, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

Outputs:
  MediaPackageChannelId:
    Description: ID of the MediaPackage live channel.
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  HlsOriginEndpointUrl:
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Description: URL of the HLS origin endpoint.
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url
  DashOriginEndpointUrl:
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Description: URL of the DASH origin endpoint.
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url
  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Description: ID of the VOD packaging group.
    Value: !Ref VodPackagingGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for the
  x86_64 and arm64 architectures. The image recipes install Docker, Docker
  Compose and common Python packages (synapseclient, pandas, pysftp), and enable
  SSM user sudo access. The resulting AMIs are distributed publicly and shared
  with a configurable AWS Organization ID.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image Builder Settings
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
          - OrganizationId
    ParameterLabels:
      ImageVersion:
        default: Image version
      RootVolumeSize:
        default: Root volume size (GiB)
      OrganizationId:
        default: AWS Organization ID

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version such as 1.0.0.
    Description: Semantic version applied to the Image Builder components, recipes and pipeline.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16000
    Description: Size in GiB of the root EBS volume for the built AMIs.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-xxxxxxxxxx
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID, for example o-abcdefghij.
    Description: AWS Organization ID that receives launch permission on the built AMIs.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM - instance profile used by the EC2 Image Builder build instances
  ##############################################################################

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ##############################################################################
  # Image Builder components - software installation and test phase
  ##############################################################################

  InstallSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-install-software'
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, and enables SSM user sudo access.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ${AWS::StackName}-install-software
        description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, and enables SSM user sudo access
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker curl
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - curl -SL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - docker compose version
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3-pip
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: ConfigureSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  TestSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-software'
      Description: Test phase that verifies Docker Compose availability and Python package imports.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ${AWS::StackName}-test-software
        description: Test phase that verifies Docker Compose availability and Python package imports
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker --version
                    - docker compose version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient"
                    - python3 -c "import pandas"
                    - python3 -c "import pysftp"

  ##############################################################################
  # Image recipes - one per architecture, sharing the same components
  ##############################################################################

  ImageRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe-x86'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 recipe with Docker and Python tooling.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe-arm64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 recipe with Docker and Python tooling.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##############################################################################
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  ##############################################################################

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for the x86_64 and arm64 builds.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t4g.medium
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##############################################################################
  # Distribution configuration - public AMIs shared with the organization
  ##############################################################################

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: Publishes the built AMIs publicly and shares them with the configured AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersion }}'
            Description: !Sub 'AMI built by the ${AWS::StackName} EC2 Image Builder pipeline from Amazon Linux 2023.'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##############################################################################
  # Image pipelines - one per architecture
  ##############################################################################

  ImagePipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86'
      Description: Builds the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Architecture: x86_64

  ImagePipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arm64'
      Description: Builds the Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Architecture: arm64

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineX86Arn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 EC2 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineX86

  ImagePipelineArm64Arn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 EC2 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineArm64

  ImageRecipeX86Arn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 image recipe.
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeX86

  ImageRecipeArm64Arn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image recipe.
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64

  InstallSoftwareComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the software installation component.
    Value: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared distribution configuration.
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfileName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication platform built on Amazon Cognito.
  Creates a PLUS tier user pool with advanced security ENFORCED, email sign-in,
  admin-only user creation, guest/staff custom attributes, staff role groups, a
  public SPA client (SRP, no secret), an admin client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH),
  and an M2M OAuth2 client backed by a dedicated resource server.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for naming and exports.

Resources:

  AnyCompanyHotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: !Sub "Your AnyCompany Hotel (${Environment}) account"
          EmailMessage: "Welcome to AnyCompany Hotel. Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}."
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
          - Name: admin_only
            Priority: 2
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
          PasswordHistorySize: 12
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Schema:
        - Name: custom:guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: custom:property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: custom:region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: AnyCompanyHotel

  AnyCompanyHotelUserPoolDomain:

          ScopeDescription: Read access to the AnyCompany Hotel API.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to the AnyCompany Hotel API.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to the AnyCompany Hotel API.

  SpaUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa"

      ExplicitAuthFlows:

      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Hospitality Insights (prod) Amazon Cognito user pool: post-authentication Lambda
  trigger that records custom:last_login, Admin/RegularUser/PowerUser groups, an
  optional OIDC federated identity provider, and a hosted UI domain prefix.

Parameters:
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: 3-63 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens; cannot start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: Globally unique prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain.
  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/oauth2/callback
    Description: Allowed callback (redirect) URL for the hosted UI.
  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/logout
    Description: Allowed logout URL for the hosted UI.
  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of the federated identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SsoLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: OIDC issuer (login) URL of the federated identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SsoClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Client ID issued by the federated identity provider.
  SsoClientSecret:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Client secret issued by the federated identity provider.

Conditions:
  EnableSso: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, ""]]

Resources:
  HospitalityInsightsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: HospitalityInsights
        Environment: prod
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 14
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt LastLoginFunction.Arn

  LastLoginFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: hospitality-insights-prod-last-login-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UpdateCognitoUserAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"

  LastLoginFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: hospitality-insights-prod-record-last-login
      Description: Updates the custom:last_login attribute on Cognito post-authentication.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LastLoginFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime

          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
              cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=event["userPoolId"],
                  Username=event["userName"],
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": now},
                  ],
              )
              return event

  LastLoginFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LastLoginFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt HospitalityInsightsUserPool.Arn

  SsoIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSso
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        oidc_issuer: !Ref SsoLoginUrl
        client_id: !Ref SsoClientId
        client_secret: !Ref SsoClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        attributes_request_method: GET
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        email_verified: email_verified
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name

  HospitalityInsightsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - !If [EnableSso, !Ref SsoIdentityProvider, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutUrl
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24

  HostedUiDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:

      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin

  RegularUserGroup:

  PowerUserGroup:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) cross-region chaos engineering experiment
  template. The experiment blocks network connectivity from the local deployment
  region to a configurable target region and pauses cross-region replication for
  S3 buckets and DynamoDB global tables for a configurable duration (default 20
  minutes). Only resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true (transit gateways, subnets,
  S3 buckets, DynamoDB global tables) are targeted. The template also provisions
  the required FIS IAM execution role and an encrypted CloudWatch log group
  backed by a dedicated KMS customer managed key.

Parameters:

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\\d$"
    Description: >-
      Target AWS region whose application network traffic should be blocked
      from the local deployment region during the experiment.

  ChaosDurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1440
    Description: >-
      Duration in minutes for which the chaos actions are applied. Defaults to
      20 minutes.

Resources:

  FisExperimentLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt AWS FIS experiment logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdminPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"

  FisExperimentLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/fis-experiment-logging-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisExperimentLogKmsKey

  FisExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/fis/chaos-engineering-experiments-${AWS::StackName}"
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "fis-chaos-experiment-role-${AWS::StackName}"
      Description: IAM role assumed by AWS FIS to execute the cross-region chaos experiment
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFisToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisChaosExperimentExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: TagBasedTargetResolution
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: TransitGatewayAndRouteTableConnectivityDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: S3CrossRegionReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DynamoDBCrossRegionReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsForExperimentLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              - Sid: KmsAccessForEncryptedLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogKmsKey.Arn

  CrossRegionChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub >-
        Cross-region chaos experiment that blocks application network traffic
        from ${AWS::Region} to ${TargetRegion} and pauses cross-region
        replication for ${ChaosDurationMinutes} minutes on resources tagged
        ChaosAllowed=true.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Targets:
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
        DynamoDBGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
      Actions:
        DisruptNetworkToTargetRegion:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: !Sub "Block application network traffic from ${AWS::Region} to ${TargetRegion}"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "PT${ChaosDurationMinutes}M"
            scope: region
            targetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
            TransitGateways: TransitGateways
        PauseS3CrossRegionReplication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: Pause cross-region replication on S3 buckets tagged ChaosAllowed=true
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "PT${ChaosDurationMinutes}M"
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3Buckets
        PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause cross-region replication on DynamoDB global tables tagged ChaosAllowed=true
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "PT${ChaosDurationMinutes}M"
          Targets:
            GlobalTables: DynamoDBGlobalTables

Outputs:

  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: The ID of the AWS FIS cross-region chaos experiment template
    Value: !Ref CrossRegionChaosExperimentTemplate

  ExperimentRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by AWS FIS for the experiment
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn

  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the KMS encrypted CloudWatch log group used for FIS experiment logging
    Value: !Ref FisExperimentLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment. Provisions a VPC with
  public and private subnets across two Availability Zones, NAT gateways, public
  and private route tables, a Transit Gateway (ASN 64512) with DNS and VPN ECMP
  support, private routes that send 10.0.0.0/8 toward the Transit Gateway, VPC
  flow logs to CloudWatch, and interface/gateway VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2
  Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Name prefix applied to all resources created by this stack.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the landing zone hub VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.

  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: Private Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Transit Gateway.

  SpokeRouteCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: '^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block routed toward the Transit Gateway for spoke connectivity.

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for the VPC flow log CloudWatch log group.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HubVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT gateways (one per public subnet / AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSpokeRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref SpokeRouteCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSpokeRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref SpokeRouteCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} hub Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke attachment'
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC to interface VPC endpoints.
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from the hub VPC CIDR to interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS responses within the hub VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SpokeRouteCidr
          Description: HTTPS to spoke networks via the Transit Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  WorkloadSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Default security group for workloads in the private subnets.
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the hub VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SpokeRouteCidr
          Description: HTTPS from spoke networks via the Transit Gateway
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints within the hub VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SpokeRouteCidr
          Description: HTTPS to spoke networks via the Transit Gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: DNS resolution within the hub VPC
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: DNS resolution within the hub VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-workload-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to the CloudWatch log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SsmInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-role'
      Description: Allows EC2 instances in the private subnets to be managed by Systems Manager.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SsmInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref SsmInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC flow logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsRole
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: '*'

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the landing zone hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref HubVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-HubVpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the landing zone hub VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt HubVpc.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-HubVpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private route table.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable1Id'

  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private route table.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable2Id'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-InternetGatewayId'

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in the first public subnet.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NatGateway1Id'

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in the second public subnet.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NatGateway2Id'

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway hub.
