AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 log-based monitoring. Provisions a KMS
  customer managed key, a CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CloudTrail
  management events, a CloudTrail trail with the supporting S3 bucket and IAM
  role, an encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications, and per-control metric
  filters, CloudWatch alarms and Logs Insights query definitions.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # KMS customer managed key used for the log group, SNS topic, trail bucket
  # and CloudTrail trail log encryption
  ###############################################################################
  CisMonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for CIS Section 3 log-based monitoring (CloudWatch Logs, SNS, S3, CloudTrail)
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrail
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
          - Sid: AllowSNS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  CisMonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-monitoring-cmk
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisMonitoringKey

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs log group receiving CloudTrail management events
  ###############################################################################
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/cis-monitoring-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn

  ###############################################################################
  # SNS topic encrypted with the CMK, used for alarm notifications
  ###############################################################################
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'cis-monitoring-alarms-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      DisplayName: CIS Monitoring Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOwnerAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'SNS:*'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudTrail trail delivering management events into the log group
  ###############################################################################
  CloudTrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'cis-cloudtrail-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireCloudTrailLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  CloudTrailBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:GetBucketAcl'
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                's3:x-amz-acl': 'bucket-owner-full-control'
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CloudTrailBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cis-cloudtrail-to-cwl-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Allows CloudTrail to write management events to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'

  CloudTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    DependsOn:
      - CloudTrailBucketPolicy
      - CisMonitoringKeyAlias
    Properties:
      TrailName: !Sub 'cis-management-events-${AWS::Region}'
      S3BucketName: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      S3KeyPrefix: !Sub 'AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}'
      KMSKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
      IsLogging: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true

  ###############################################################################
  # Metric filters (CIS 3.1 - 3.14)
  ###############################################################################
  UnauthorizedApiCallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedAccess*") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") || ($.errorCode = "Client.UnauthorizedOperation*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
          MetricValue: '1'

  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: RootAccountUsage
          MetricValue: '1'

  IamPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "DeleteGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  CloudTrailConfigChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "CreateTrail") || ($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
          MetricValue: '1'

  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DisableKey") || ($.eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: KMSKeyDisableOrScheduleDeletion
          MetricValue: '1'

  S3BucketPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "PutBucketAcl") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketCors") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketLifecycle") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketReplication") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketCors") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketLifecycle") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketReplication")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: S3BucketPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  AwsConfigChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "config.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "StopConfigurationRecorder") || ($.eventName = "DeleteDeliveryChannel") || ($.eventName = "PutDeliveryChannel") || ($.eventName = "PutConfigurationRecorder")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: AWSConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  SecurityGroupChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress") || ($.eventName = "AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress") || ($.eventName = "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress") || ($.eventName = "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress") || ($.eventName = "CreateSecurityGroup") || ($.eventName = "DeleteSecurityGroup")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: SecurityGroupChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  NetworkAclChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateNetworkAcl") || ($.eventName = "CreateNetworkAclEntry") || ($.eventName = "DeleteNetworkAcl") || ($.eventName = "DeleteNetworkAclEntry") || ($.eventName = "ReplaceNetworkAclEntry") || ($.eventName = "ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: NetworkACLChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  NetworkGatewayChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateCustomerGateway") || ($.eventName = "DeleteCustomerGateway") || ($.eventName = "AttachInternetGateway") || ($.eventName = "CreateInternetGateway") || ($.eventName = "DeleteInternetGateway") || ($.eventName = "DetachInternetGateway")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: NetworkGatewayChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  RouteTableChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateRoute") || ($.eventName = "CreateRouteTable") || ($.eventName = "ReplaceRoute") || ($.eventName = "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRouteTable") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRoute") || ($.eventName = "DisassociateRouteTable")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: RouteTableChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  VpcChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateVpc") || ($.eventName = "DeleteVpc") || ($.eventName = "ModifyVpcAttribute") || ($.eventName = "AcceptVpcPeeringConnection") || ($.eventName = "CreateVpcPeeringConnection") || ($.eventName = "DeleteVpcPeeringConnection") || ($.eventName = "RejectVpcPeeringConnection") || ($.eventName = "AttachClassicLinkVpc") || ($.eventName = "DetachClassicLinkVpc") || ($.eventName = "DisableVpcClassicLink") || ($.eventName = "EnableVpcClassicLink")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISLogMetrics
          MetricName: VPCChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch alarms (threshold 1, missing data not breaching, notify SNS)
  ###############################################################################
  UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API call attempts detected in CloudTrail'
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Namespace: CISLogMetrics
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:

      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.3 - Use of the root account detected'
      ActionsEnabled: true

      MetricName: RootAccountUsage

      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300

      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.4 - IAM policy changes detected'
      ActionsEnabled: true

      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1

  CloudTrailConfigChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:

      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration changes detected'

      MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges

      Statistic: Sum

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs Insights query definitions (CIS 3.1 - 3.14)

  UnauthorizedApiCallsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn, eventSource, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion
        | filter errorCode like /UnauthorizedAccess|AccessDenied|Client.UnauthorizedOperation/
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, responseElements.ConsoleLogin, additionalEventData.MFAUsed
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" and responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  RootAccountUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.3-RootAccountUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.type, eventSource, eventName, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion

        | limit 100

    Properties:

      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |

  SecurityGroupChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.10-SecurityGroupChanges

        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, eventSource, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress
        | filter eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress", "AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress", "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress", "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress", "CreateSecurityGroup", "DeleteSecurityGroup"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  NetworkAclChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.11-NetworkACLChanges

        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |

  NetworkGatewayChangesQuery:

    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.12-NetworkGatewayChanges

        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, eventSource, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress

    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.13-RouteTableChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, eventSource, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress
        | filter eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["CreateRoute", "CreateRouteTable", "ReplaceRoute", "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation", "DeleteRouteTable", "DeleteRoute", "DisassociateRouteTable"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  VpcChangesQuery:

    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.14-VPCChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, eventSource, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Shared IAM roles, GuardDuty detector and CloudFormation registry type activations used by multiple EKS deployments.

Parameters:
  EnvAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: shared
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+$"
    Description: Optional environment alias used as the prefix for every role name.
  EnvHash:
    Type: String
    Default: "0000"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 8
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]+$"
    Description: Optional short hash appended after the environment alias to keep role names unique.
  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ARN of an IAM policy applied as a permissions boundary to every role created by this stack. Leave empty to deploy without a boundary; environments that require a boundary must set this value.
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: shared-eks-artifacts
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$"
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket the bastion role is allowed to read objects from. The bastion S3 policy is scoped to this bucket only.

Conditions:
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
      - ""

Resources:

  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  RegistryKubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 30

  RegistryKubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30

  RegistryEksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 30

  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-${EnvHash}-lambda-discovery-role"
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access used for resource discovery.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
        - PolicyName: ResourceDiscoveryReadOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-${EnvHash}-lambda-caller-identity-role"
      Description: Lambda role that retrieves the caller identity and reads CloudFormation and CloudTrail log data.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndAuditReads
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*:*"

  EksNodeGroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-${EnvHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role"
      Description: Role used to describe EKS clusters and managed node groups.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EksNodeGroupDescribe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-${EnvHash}-cfn-execution-role"
      Description: Execution role for CloudFormation stacks and CloudFormation registry type activations.
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PlatformManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: S3Management
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: BucketLevelOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:PutBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketEncryption
                  - s3:PutBucketEncryption
                  - s3:GetBucketCORS
                  - s3:PutBucketCORS
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${S3BucketName}"
              - Sid: ObjectLevelOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*"

  CloudFormationLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-${EnvHash}-cfn-logging-role"
      Description: Logging delivery role CloudFormation assumes to write registry extension logs.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegistryLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*:*"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Comprehensive Amazon SQS test infrastructure: FIFO queue without a dead-letter
  queue, FIFO queue with a dead-letter queue (plus that DLQ), standard queue with a
  redrive policy (maxReceiveCount 5) and its DLQ, a separate FIFO DLQ, a customer
  managed KMS key that encrypts every queue, and CloudWatch alarms with alarm
  actions disabled.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # KMS key used to encrypt every queue in this template
  ###############################################################################
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt all SQS queues in this template
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: sqs-queues-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"

  ###############################################################################
  # Queues
  ###############################################################################

  # FIFO queue without a dead-letter queue
  FifoQueueWithoutDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn

  # FIFO queue that uses a dead-letter queue
  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Dead-letter queue for the FIFO queue above
  FifoQueueWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn

  # Standard queue with a redrive policy (maximum receive count of 5)
  StandardQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Dead-letter queue for the standard queue above
  StandardQueueWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn

  # Additional, standalone FIFO dead-letter queue
  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch alarms (all with alarm actions disabled)
  ###############################################################################

  # Sum of messages sent to the standard queue; missing data is breaching
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-messages-sent-sum
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent to the standard queue with a threshold of 1 (missing data breaching)
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Average messages sent to the FIFO queue with DLQ, using an anomaly detection band
  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-queue-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly-band
      AlarmDescription: Average messages sent to the FIFO queue with DLQ, evaluated with an anomaly detection band
      Metrics:
        - Id: messages_sent
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
            Unit: Count
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: anomaly_band
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(messages_sent, 2)
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent expected band
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum sent message size on the standard queue
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-sent-message-size-max
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the standard queue with a threshold of 183500 bytes
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue
  SeparateFifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-sent-message-size-max
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue with a threshold of 183500 bytes
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Sum of visible messages on the standard DLQ, alerting when greater than zero
  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Sum of visible messages on the standard DLQ, alerting when greater than zero
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlqDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Sum of visible messages on the separate FIFO DLQ, alerting when greater than zero
  SeparateFifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:

      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible

          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard queue
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:

      AlarmName: standard-queue-oldest-message-age-max

      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue
  SeparateFifoQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-oldest-message-age-max
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue with a threshold of 15 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum number of not visible messages on the standard queue
  StandardQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-not-visible-messages-max
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of not visible messages on the standard queue with a threshold of 108000
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum number of not visible messages on the separate FIFO queue
  SeparateFifoQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-not-visible-messages-max
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of not visible messages on the separate FIFO queue with a threshold of 18000
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ
  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-oldest-message-age-max
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ with a threshold of 90 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlqDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK (missing data is not breaching)
  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: synthetic-always-ok
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK; missing data is treated as not breaching
      Namespace: CloudFormation/Synthetic
      MetricName: AlwaysOk
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 3600
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Prerequisite resources (CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group, KMS customer
  managed key, SSM Automation execution role, and CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs
  role) together with nine AWS Systems Manager Automation documents used for
  automated remediation of PCI DSS controls. All outputs are exported so they
  can be consumed by custom AWS Config conformance packs.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group (1827 day retention)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: KMS customer managed key (rotation enabled, root full access)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PciKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer managed key for PCI DSS remediation (CloudTrail / IAM encryption).
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: pci-dss-remediation-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  PciKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-pci-dss-remediation"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PciKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation documents
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the PCI DSS SSM Automation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: IAM role for CloudTrail -> CloudWatch Logs delivery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role that allows CloudTrail to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateLogStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: !Sub "${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*"
              - Sid: PutLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*"
              - Sid: ManageLogGroupsAndStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 1
  # Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a provided KMS key AND integrate it with
  # CloudWatch Logs.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EncryptTrailWithKmsAndCloudWatchLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-EncryptTrailWithKmsAndCloudWatchLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate it with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to update.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail uses to write to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              KmsKeyId: "{{ KmsKeyId }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdatedTrailName
                Selector: "$.Name"
                Type: String

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 2
  # Enable key rotation for a specified KMS key.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-EnableKmsKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Enable automatic rotation for the specified KMS key.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: ARN or ID of the KMS key for which rotation is enabled.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: "{{ KeyId }}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 3
  # Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to update.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail uses to write to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: IntegrateCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdatedTrailName
                Selector: "$.Name"
                Type: String

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 4
  # Update the account IAM password policy.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-UpdateIamPasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: >-
          Update the account IAM password policy to enforce a minimum length of
          14 characters, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, allow password
          change, hard expiry, a maximum password age of 90 days, and prevent
          reuse of the last 24 passwords.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 5
  # Enable log file validation, multi-region, and CloudWatch Logs integration.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableTrailLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-EnableTrailLogFileValidationMultiRegionCloudWatch
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: >-
          Enable CloudTrail log file validation for a trail while ensuring the
          trail is multi-region and integrated with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to update.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail uses to write to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableLogFileValidationMultiRegionAndCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdatedTrailName
                Selector: "$.Name"
                Type: String

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 6
  # Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a given default security group.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on the specified default security group.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group whose rules are revoked.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: revoke_all_rules
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: "{{ GroupId }}"
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def revoke_all_rules(events, context):
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    groups = response.get('SecurityGroups', [])
                    if not groups:
                        raise Exception('Security group not found: ' + group_id)
                    group = groups[0]
                    ingress = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=ingress)
                    if egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=egress)
                    return {
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'IngressRulesRevoked': len(ingress),
                        'EgressRulesRevoked': len(egress)
                    }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 7
  # Delete a specified security group.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DeleteSecurityGroup
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Delete the specified security group.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: "{{ GroupId }}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 8
  # Release an unused Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReleaseElasticIpDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-ReleaseUnusedElasticIp
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Release an unused Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: "{{ AllocationId }}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 9
  # Remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY env vars from a CodeBuild
  # project.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RemoveCodeBuildCredentialEnvVarsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-RemoveCodeBuildCredentialEnvVars
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: >-
          Update a CodeBuild project to remove any environment variables named
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
            default: ""
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to update.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveCredentialEnvironmentVariables
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: remove_credentials_env_vars
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: "{{ ProjectName }}"
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def remove_credentials_env_vars(events, context):
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    blocked = ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception('CodeBuild project not found: ' + project_name)
                    project = projects[0]
                    environment = project['environment']
                    env_vars = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    removed = [v['name'] for v in env_vars if v.get('name') in blocked]
                    if not removed:
                        return {'ProjectName': project_name, 'RemovedVariables': []}
                    filtered = [v for v in env_vars if v.get('name') not in blocked]
                    new_environment = {
                        'type': environment['type'],
                        'image': environment['image'],
                        'computeType': environment['computeType'],
                        'environmentVariables': filtered
                    }
                    for optional_key in ('privilegedMode', 'imagePullCredentialsType', 'registryCredential'):
                        if optional_key in environment:
                            new_environment[optional_key] = environment[optional_key]
                    codebuild.update_project(name=project_name, environment=new_environment)
                    return {'ProjectName': project_name, 'RemovedVariables': removed}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs (exported for use by custom AWS Config conformance packs)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:

  CloudTrailLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogGroupName"

  CloudTrailLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogGroupArn"

  KmsKeyId:
    Description: ID of the PCI DSS remediation KMS customer managed key.
    Value: !Ref PciKmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId"

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the PCI DSS remediation KMS customer managed key.
    Value: !GetAtt PciKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn"

  SsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation documents.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SsmAutomationRoleArn"

  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by CloudTrail to write to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn"

  EncryptTrailWithKmsAndCloudWatchLogsDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that encrypts a trail with KMS and integrates CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !Ref EncryptTrailWithKmsAndCloudWatchLogsDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EncryptTrailWithKmsAndCloudWatchLogsDocumentName"

  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that enables KMS key rotation.
    Value: !Ref EnableKmsKeyRotationDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EnableKmsKeyRotationDocumentName"

  IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogsDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that integrates a trail with CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !Ref IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogsDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogsDocumentName"

  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that updates the IAM password policy.
    Value: !Ref UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocument
    Export:
