AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  CoWork telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork) and Claude Code for
  Desktop. Creates an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group, metric filters that
  extract input/output/cache token, estimated cost and session-turn metrics
  from both CoWork event schemas (local agent mode and Claude Code for
  Desktop), and a CloudWatch dashboard with usage, cost, cache, session and
  per-user views plus a recent raw events table.

Parameters:

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWork-Telemetry
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard to create.

  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/cowork/telemetry
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    AllowedPattern: "^[\\.\\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name.
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CoWork telemetry events.

  MetricsNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWork/Telemetry
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for the CoWork telemetry metrics.

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    Description: Region that the dashboard widgets query for CoWork telemetry metrics.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain CoWork telemetry log events.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encrypted log group that receives CoWork telemetry events
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TelemetryLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt CoWork telemetry CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:Describe*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"

  CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt TelemetryLogsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Schema A: CoWork local agent mode
  #   { "schema": "cowork.local_agent.v1", "input_tokens": 1234,
  #     "output_tokens": 567, "cache_read_tokens": 890,
  #     "cache_creation_tokens": 123, "estimated_cost_usd": 0.0456,
  #     "turns": 4, "user": "alice@example.com", "model": "claude-sonnet-4" }
  #
  # Schema B: Claude Code for Desktop
  #   { "schema": "cowork.desktop.coding.v1", "usage": { "inputTokens": 2345,
  #     "outputTokens": 678, "cacheReadInputTokens": 901,
  #     "cacheCreationInputTokens": 234 }, "costUsd": 0.0789, "turnCount": 5,
  #     "userEmail": "alice@example.com", "modelId": "claude-opus-4" }
  #
  # Both schemas publish into the SAME metric names so that the dashboard sees
  # a single unified metric per signal. Attribution (per user) metrics carry a
  # User dimension; unattributed aggregate metrics omit dimensions and rely on
  # DefaultValue 0 so a zero is still published when a value cannot be matched.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # --- Schema A: aggregate (no dimensions), always publish a value ----------

  LocalAgentInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.input_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalAgentOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.output_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalAgentCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cache_read_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalAgentCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cache_creation_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalAgentEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: "$.estimated_cost_usd"
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: "$.turns"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  # --- Schema A: per-user attribution (User dimension) ----------------------

  LocalAgentUserInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserInputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.input_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"

  LocalAgentUserOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserOutputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.output_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"

  LocalAgentUserCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserCacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cache_read_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"

  LocalAgentUserCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserCacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cache_creation_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"

  LocalAgentUserEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserEstimatedCost
          MetricValue: "$.estimated_cost_usd"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"

  LocalAgentUserSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.local_agent.v1" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserSessionTurns
          MetricValue: "$.turns"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"

  # --- Schema B: aggregate (no dimensions), always publish a value ----------

  DesktopInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.inputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  DesktopOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.outputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  DesktopCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.cacheReadInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  DesktopCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.cacheCreationInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  DesktopEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: "$.costUsd"
          DefaultValue: 0

  DesktopSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: "$.turnCount"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  # --- Schema B: per-user attribution (User dimension) ----------------------

  DesktopUserInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" && $.userEmail = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserInputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.inputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userEmail"

  DesktopUserOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" && $.userEmail = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserOutputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.outputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userEmail"

  DesktopUserCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" && $.userEmail = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserCacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.cacheReadInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userEmail"

  DesktopUserCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" && $.userEmail = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserCacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: "$.usage.cacheCreationInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userEmail"

  DesktopUserEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" && $.userEmail = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserEstimatedCost
          MetricValue: "$.costUsd"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userEmail"

  DesktopUserSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "cowork.desktop.coding.v1" && $.userEmail = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: UserSessionTurns
          MetricValue: "$.turnCount"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userEmail"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch dashboard
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CoWorkTelemetryDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Input Tokens",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 4, "y": 0, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Output Tokens",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "OutputTokens", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 8, "y": 0, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Token Usage (Input + Output)",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "tokIn", "visible": false } ],
                    [ ".", "OutputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "tokOut", "visible": false } ],
                    [ { "expression": "tokIn + tokOut", "label": "Total Tokens", "id": "totalTokens" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12, "y": 0, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Estimated Cost (USD)",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 16, "y": 0, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Session Turns",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "SessionTurns", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 20, "y": 0, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Cache Read Tokens",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 5, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Cache Creation Tokens",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 4, "y": 5, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Cache Hit Tokens (Read + Creation)",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "cacheRead", "visible": false } ],
                    [ ".", "CacheCreationTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "cacheCreate", "visible": false } ],
                    [ { "expression": "cacheRead + cacheCreate", "label": "Cache Hit Tokens", "id": "cacheTotal" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 8, "y": 5, "width": 4, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Average Cost per Turn (USD)",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "costSum", "visible": false } ],
                    [ ".", "SessionTurns", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "turnSum", "visible": false } ],
                    [ { "expression": "costSum / turnSum", "label": "Avg Cost per Turn (USD)", "id": "avgCostPerTurn" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 12, "y": 5, "width": 12, "height": 5,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Active Users",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroup}' | fields coalesce(user, userEmail) as userName | stats count_distinct(userName) as ActiveUsers by bin(1h)"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 10, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Token Usage Over Time",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 3600,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Input Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "OutputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Output Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "CacheReadTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Cache Read Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "CacheCreationTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Cache Creation Tokens" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12, "y": 10, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Estimated Cost Trend Over Time (USD)",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 3600,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Estimated Cost (USD)" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 16, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Per-User Token Usage",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 3600,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricsNamespace},User} MetricName=\"UserInputTokens\"', 'Sum', 3600)", "label": "Input Tokens (per user)", "id": "perUserIn" } ],

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS CDK bootstrap environment. Provisions the S3 file asset
  bucket, ECR container asset repository, KMS encryption key, IAM roles for
  publishing/lookup/deployment/CloudFormation execution, and the SSM parameter
  that tracks the bootstrap version. All resources are created within this
  template and are uniquely identified by the Qualifier value.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Bootstrap Configuration
        Parameters:
          - Qualifier
          - BootstrapVersion
          - TrustedAccounts
          - CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
      - Label:
          default: Asset Storage
        Parameters:
          - FileAssetBucketName
          - ImageAssetRepositoryName
      - Label:
          default: Encryption
        Parameters:
          - FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
          - FileAssetKeyAlias
    ParameterLabels:
      Qualifier:
        default: Qualifier
      BootstrapVersion:
        default: Bootstrap Version
      TrustedAccounts:
        default: Trusted Account IDs
      CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
        default: CloudFormation Execution Managed Policies
      FileAssetBucketName:
        default: File Asset Bucket Name
      ImageAssetRepositoryName:
        default: Container Asset Repository Name
      FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
        default: Existing KMS Key ARN
      FileAssetKeyAlias:
        default: KMS Key Alias

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    MinLength: 5
    MaxLength: 10
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]{5,10}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 5-10 lowercase letters or digits.
    Description: >-
      Short, unique string that identifies every bootstrap resource in this
      account and Region. It is embedded in resource names and the SSM path.

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "21"
    Description: Version of the CDK bootstrap resources recorded in SSM.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of additional AWS account IDs that are allowed to
      assume the bootstrap roles. The current account is always trusted.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of IAM managed policy ARNs attached to the
      CloudFormation execution role.

  FileAssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional custom name for the S3 bucket that stores CDK file assets. When
      empty, CloudFormation generates a unique name.

  ImageAssetRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional custom name for the ECR repository that stores CDK container
      assets. When empty, CloudFormation generates a unique name.

  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing KMS key used to encrypt CDK assets. When
      empty, a new KMS key is created by this template.

  FileAssetKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional KMS alias (without the "alias/" prefix) for the generated key.
      Ignored when an existing KMS key is supplied.

Conditions:
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TrustedAccounts, ""]]
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies, ""]]
  HasCustomFileAssetBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetBucketName, ""]]
  HasCustomImageAssetRepositoryName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ImageAssetRepositoryName, ""]]
  HasCustomFileAssetKeyAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetKeyAlias, ""]]
  CreateNewKey: !Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, ""]

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ KMS ---
  FileAssetKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key used to encrypt CDK assets (qualifier ${Qualifier})"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowAssetAndExecutionRolesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  FileAssetKeyAliasEntry:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If
        - HasCustomFileAssetKeyAlias
        - !Sub "alias/${FileAssetKeyAlias}"
        - !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------- S3 ---
  FileAssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomFileAssetBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetBucketName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKey
                - !GetAtt FileAssetKey.Arn
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  FileAssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ ECR ---
  ImageAssetRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !If
        - HasCustomImageAssetRepositoryName
        - !Ref ImageAssetRepositoryName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !If
          - CreateNewKey
          - !GetAtt FileAssetKey.Arn
          - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images after 14 days",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 14
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------- IAM ROLES ---
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Role assumed by the CDK CLI to publish file assets to the asset bucket.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Sub "${AWS::AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}"]
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingRoleDefaultPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetKey.Arn
                  - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Role assumed by the CDK CLI to publish container images to the asset repository.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Sub "${AWS::AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}"]
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingRoleDefaultPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageAssetRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetKey.Arn
                  - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Role assumed by the CDK CLI to perform environment lookups.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Sub "${AWS::AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}"]
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupRoleDefaultPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListExports
                  - cloudformation:ListImports
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Role assumed by the CDK CLI to perform CloudFormation deployments.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Sub "${AWS::AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}"]
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActionRoleDefaultPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: "*"

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Role passed to CloudFormation to execute the deployed stacks.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Split [",", !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies]
        - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationExecutionRoleDefaultPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
                Resource: !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetKey.Arn
                  - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId

  # ----------------------------------------------------------- SSM PARAM ---
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for the ML Workshop. Creates an
  admin portfolio and an end user portfolio, seven CloudFormation products backed
  by nested templates, a dedicated launch role and launch role constraint per
  product, the Service Catalog admin lead and end user IAM roles (with read and
  describe permissions, MLWorkshop SSM parameter access and access to S3 objects
  tagged for provisioning), portfolio principal associations, and the switch role
  URLs for both end users.

Parameters:

  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: >-
      HTTPS URL of the S3 folder that stores the nested CloudFormation templates
      used to back the Service Catalog products.

  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumeric
      characters and hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to every resource name so that multiple workshop
      participants can share a single account.

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # Portfolios
  #############################################################################

  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub 'ML Workshop Admin Portfolio (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Description: >-
        Portfolio used by the ML Workshop administrators to publish and manage
        the workshop products.
      ProviderName: ML Workshop Admin Team
      AcceptLanguage: en
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub 'ML Workshop End User Portfolio (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Description: >-
        Portfolio used by ML Workshop end users to self-provision the workshop
        assets.
      ProviderName: ML Workshop
      AcceptLanguage: en
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  #############################################################################
  # Products
  #############################################################################

  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop VPC (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        VPC with public and private subnets, NAT gateways and interface and
        gateway VPC endpoints.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: VPC with private subnets and endpoints
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/vpc.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  IAMProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop IAM KMS and S3 (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        IAM roles, customer managed KMS keys and encrypted S3 buckets used by
        the workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/iam-kms-s3.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop AWS Data Exchange (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        AWS Data Exchange subscription that delivers third-party data sets into
        the workshop account.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: AWS Data Exchange product subscription
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/data-exchange.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop Infrastructure (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        Shared workshop infrastructure such as compute, storage and networking
        add-ons.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Shared workshop infrastructure
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/infrastructure.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop Application (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        Application tier used to consume the third-party data and the ML models
        produced during the workshop.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Workshop application tier
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/application.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop SageMaker Notebook Instance (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        Amazon SageMaker notebook instance with its IAM role and lifecycle
        configuration.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: SageMaker notebook instance
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/sagemaker-notebook.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ThirdPartyMLModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ML Workshop Third-Party ML Model (${EnvironmentPrefix})'
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: >-
        Third-party machine learning model deployed from AWS Marketplace into a
        private SageMaker endpoint.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Third-party ML model
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/third-party-ml-model.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  #############################################################################

  #############################################################################

  ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy

          - Sid: S3Provisioning

            Action:
              - s3:CreateBucket
              - s3:DeleteBucket
              - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
              - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
              - s3:GetBucketEncryption
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetBucketPolicy
              - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
              - s3:GetBucketTagging
              - s3:GetBucketVersioning

              - s3:PutObject

            Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:DescribeKey

              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'

          - Sid: EC2Provisioning
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress

              - ec2:CreateVpc

              - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs

              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways

              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances

            Resource: '*'

          - Sid: LogsProvisioning
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DeleteLogGroup
              - logs:DeleteLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:ListTagsLogGroup
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
              - logs:TagLogGroup

            Effect: Allow

  #############################################################################

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-VPC'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop VPC product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  IAMLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-IAM'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop IAM/KMS/S3 product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  DataExchangeLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-DataExchange'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop AWS Data Exchange product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  InfrastructureLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-Infrastructure'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop infrastructure product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  ApplicationLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-Application'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop application product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  SageMakerLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-SageMaker'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop SageMaker notebook product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  ThirdPartyModelLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshopLaunchRole-ThirdPartyModel'
      Description: Dedicated Service Catalog launch role for the ML Workshop third-party ML model product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ServiceCatalogLaunchPolicy

  #############################################################################
  # Portfolio / product associations
  #############################################################################

  AdminPortfolioVPCProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct

  AdminPortfolioIAMProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMProduct

  AdminPortfolioDataExchangeProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  AdminPortfolioInfrastructureProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  EndUserPortfolioApplicationProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  EndUserPortfolioSageMakerNotebookProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  EndUserPortfolioThirdPartyMLModelProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLModelProduct

  #############################################################################
  # Launch role constraints
  #############################################################################

  VPCLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt VPCLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch role that provisions the ML Workshop VPC product.
      AcceptLanguage: en

  IAMLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) network for a staging or production environment.
  Provisions a VPC with three public subnets (two in the first AZ for the
  presentation/load-balancer tier, one in a second AZ for compute), two private
  subnets in the first AZ (application and data tiers), an internet gateway, an
  egress-only internet gateway, an optional NAT gateway with Elastic IP, public
  and private network ACLs, a cluster placement group, a DHCP options set, and
  stack outputs/exports for downstream stacks.

Parameters:

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Deployment environment; selects the VPC/subnet CIDRs and DHCP domain name.

  NatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >
      Deploy a NAT gateway (with an Elastic IP) for the private subnets. Set to
      false when a bastion host provides private-tier outbound connectivity.

Conditions:

  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref NatGateway, "true"]

Mappings:

  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: "10.1.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: "10.1.0.0/20"
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: "10.1.16.0/20"
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: "10.1.32.0/20"
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: "10.1.48.0/20"
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: "10.1.64.0/20"
      DomainName: "staging.internal.example.com"
    production:
      VpcCidr: "10.0.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: "10.0.0.0/20"
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: "10.0.16.0/20"
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: "10.0.32.0/20"
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: "10.0.48.0/20"
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: "10.0.64.0/20"
      DomainName: "internal.example.com"

Resources:

  ########################################
  # VPC and IPv6 association
  ########################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  ########################################
  # Gateways
  ########################################

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  ########################################
  # Public subnets (AZ 1 x2, AZ 2 x1)
  ########################################

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  ########################################
  # Private subnets (AZ 1 x2)
  ########################################

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  ########################################
  # Public routing
  ########################################

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ########################################
  # Private routing
  ########################################

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-nat-eip"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-nat-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayResource

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ########################################
  # Public network ACL
  ########################################

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-acl"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicAclIngressHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicAclIngressHttpsIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicAclIngressSshIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicAclIngressVpnIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  PublicAclIngressEphemeralIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicAclIngressHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicAclIngressHttpsIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 160
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicAclIngressSshIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 170
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicAclIngressVpnIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 180
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  PublicAclIngressEphemeralIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 190
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicAclEgressHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicAclEgressHttpsIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicAclEgressEphemeralTcpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 102
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicAclEgressEphemeralUdpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 103
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024

  PublicAclEgressHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80

  PublicAclEgressHttpsIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

      RuleAction: allow

      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443

  PublicAclEgressEphemeralTcpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 112
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024

  PublicAclEgressEphemeralUdpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 113
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicSubnet1AclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2AclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3AclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  ########################################
  # Private network ACL
  ########################################

  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-acl"
        - Key: Environment

  PrivateAclIngressTcpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101

      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0

  PrivateAclIngressTcpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110

      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"

    Properties:

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcDhcpOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
