        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          sfn=boto3.client("stepfunctions")
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN=os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"]
          def _response(status,payload):
              return {"statusCode":status,"headers":{"Content-Type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps(payload,default=str)}
          def handler(event,context):
              execution_name=(event.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("campaignId")
              if not execution_name:
                  return _response(400,{"error":"campaignId path parameter is required."})
              execution_arn=STATE_MACHINE_ARN.replace(":stateMachine:",":execution:")+":"+execution_name
              try:
                  described=sfn.describe_execution(executionArn=execution_arn)
              except ClientError as exc:
                  if exc.response["Error"]["Code"]=="ExecutionDoesNotExist":

                  raise
              payload={"campaignId":execution_name,"status":described.get("status"),"startDate":described.get("startDate"),"stopDate":described.get("stopDate")}
              output=described.get("output")
              if output:
                  try:
                      payload["result"]=json.loads(output)
                  except ValueError:
                      payload["result"]=output
              return _response(200,payload)

    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-execution-failures"
      AlarmDescription: Fires when a campaign state machine execution fails.
      Namespace: AWS/States
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertTopic]

    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::Collection
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    DependsOn: [VectorEncryptionPolicy, VectorNetworkPolicy]
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vectors"

      Description: Vector store for semantic campaign search.

    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-enc"

      Description: Encryption at rest for the vector collection.
      Policy: !Sub |
        {"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vectors"]}],"AWSOwnedKey":true}
  VectorNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-net"
      Type: network
      Description: Network access for the vector collection.
      Policy: !Sub |
        [{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vectors"]}],"AllowFromPublic":true}]
  VectorAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    DependsOn: VectorCollection
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-access"
      Type: data
      Description: Data access for the campaign pipeline role.
      Policy: !Sub
        - |
          [{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${CollectionName}"],"Permission":["aoss:DescribeCollectionItems","aoss:CreateCollectionItems","aoss:UpdateCollectionItems"]},{"ResourceType":"index","Resource":["index/${CollectionName}/*"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateIndex","aoss:DescribeIndex","aoss:UpdateIndex","aoss:DeleteIndex","aoss:ReadDocument","aoss:WriteDocument"]}],"Principal":["${PipelineRoleArn}"]}]
        - CollectionName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vectors"
          PipelineRoleArn: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
  SemanticSearchAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-semantic-search"
      Roles: [!Ref PipelineLambdaRole]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: [aoss:APIAccessAll]
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:aoss:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:collection/*"
